title: Shift posting to confirmed booking
scope: Tom, Lina and Grace post a shift (each audience level: own staff, favourites, community, public), Sara/Ben/Omar see and apply or counter-offer, the poster reviews and accepts, the payment reservation is taken and verified, the worker is confirmed and assigned. Include slots, multi-date shifts, rates and what each persona sees on web and mobile.

title: Cancellation, expiry, cover and swap
scope: Cancel one date, selected dates or a whole posting; an unpaid reservation expiring; a worker asking for cover or a swap; escalation of unfilled shifts; who is notified and charged/refunded, and what history remains.

title: Staff removal and offboarding
scope: Tom removes Ali, or Mia leaves: memberships, roster assignments, future shifts, chat rooms, hub access, notifications, websockets/sessions, invoices and timesheets after removal, and re-invite.

title: Tenant isolation across orgs, regions and pharmacies
scope: Lina (org admin of org 1) vs another org; Grace (region admin) limited to her region; Tom with two pharmacies (Nadia at the other). For every list/detail/update endpoint you can reach from these roles, check object ids from another tenant are refused, including nested ids in request bodies and query filters.

title: Sign-up, onboarding and verification
scope: Zoe signs up as Explorer and upgrades; Sara, Jack, Ali, Mia onboarding tracks; AHPRA check, identity documents, referees, skills; what gates browsing/applying/confirming/payment; what admins see and approve.

title: Attendance, kiosk, timesheets, leave and payroll
scope: Omar clocks in/out (app and kiosk with pairing and PIN), manager corrections, breaks, timesheet approval, leave requests, payroll export on web and mobile.

title: Worker invoices and payments
scope: Sara creates, revises, sends and gets paid for invoices to Tom's pharmacy; internal invoices; mark-paid; partial payments; emails; BAS/finance summaries; what Tom sees and approves.

title: Subscriptions, seats and Stripe
scope: Tom subscribes, adds/removes seats, pays for shifts via checkout, discounts; Stripe webhooks (duplicate, late, out-of-order), refunds and failed payments; what the app shows after each.

title: Chat, hub and notification privacy
scope: Pharmacy, group, org and community chats; hub posts, mentions, attachments; push, email and websocket notifications; who can read what, including after leaving, and what notification text exposes.

title: Talent board, marketplace, ratings, rewards and public pages
scope: Sara's public profile and availability, talent board search by Tom, marketplace listings, ratings and rewards, public org/pharmacy/job pages in the Next.js site: what private data reaches unauthenticated or unrelated users, and whether counts/scores can be gamed.

title: Login, sessions and account security
scope: Login, JWT refresh, logout, password reset, email/phone change, cross-tab login on web, cached identity on Expo, role switching, deleted or suspended accounts, throttling on auth endpoints.

title: Web vs mobile parity for core actions
scope: For apply, accept, counter-offer, cancel, clock in/out, invoice send and chat send: compare the Vite web flow and the Expo flow against the same backend endpoint. Report where one client lets a user do something the other blocks, sends different data, or shows wrong status.
